name: starsync
author: NomadicDaddy
description: Automatically synchronize all your starred GitHub repositories on your local drive. If a repository already exists, it will be pulled to the newest commit, otherwise it will be cloned.

scripts.build: bun run build:bundle && bun run build:types
scripts.lint:fast: eslint src scripts test eslint.config.js --cache --cache-location node_modules/.cache/eslint/ --report-unused-disable-directives --max-warnings 0
scripts.smoke:qc: bun run check:max-lines && bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run format:check && bun run check:leak-guard && bun run check:licenses && bun run test
scripts.smoke:qc:fast: bun run check:max-lines && bun run typecheck && bun run lint:fast && bun run format:check
scripts.prepare: bun ./scripts/require-bun.ts && (git config core.hooksPath .githooks && bun ./scripts/run-bash.ts .githooks/leak-guard-setup.sh || true) && bun run build
